stories.title: Constitutional Oversight or Criminal Witch Hunt? White House Threatens Democrats Over Trump Probes
stories.conservative_headline: White House Puts Democrats on Notice: Partisan Revenge Probes Won't Be Tolerated
stories.liberal_headline: Trump White House Threatens to Prosecute Congress for Doing Its Constitutional Job
stories.poll_question: Can the White House threaten Democrats over oversight investigations?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Democrats are weaponizing subpoenas for political revenge, not legitimate oversight.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Congress has constitutional authority to investigate without White House permission.

stories.title: Blowout Jobs or Broken Paychecks? Hiring Surges While Inflation Eats Wages

stories.liberal_headline: Sixth Straight Year of Price Pain: Inflation Hits 4% as Workers Fall Behind
stories.poll_question: Is the Trump economy working for ordinary Americans?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Strong hiring and low unemployment prove the economy is fundamentally healthy.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Inflation outpacing wages means families are losing purchasing power every month.

stories.title: Targeted Enforcement or Cruelty by Design? ICE Hides Detainee Locations as Lawsuit Lands

stories.liberal_headline: Disappeared: ICE Hides Thousands of Detainees From Their Own Lawyers and Families
stories.poll_question: Should ICE be required to publicly list where detainees are held?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Those with final deportation orders exhausted their process; secrecy protects agents.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Hiding detainees from attorneys and families violates basic constitutional rights.

stories.title: Victory or Quagmire? Trump Keeps Iran War at 'Status Quo' as Blockade Drags On

stories.poll_option1_desc: Economic and naval pressure crushed Iran's military without more American casualties.
stories.poll_option2_desc: An unauthorized war of choice with no exit plan and rising costs.

stories.title: Religious Liberty or State-Funded Discrimination? SCOTUS Weighs Catholic Schools Rejecting LGBTQ Families

stories.poll_option1_desc: Religious schools shouldn't abandon their beliefs to join public programs.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Public money must never fund discrimination against children or their parents.

stories.title: Accountability or Partisan Stunt? House GOP Kills Hegseth Impeachment Over Iran War Powers

stories.title: Stolen Seat or Fair Count? Democrat Wins Mississippi Senate Race as GOP Eyes Legal Challenge

stories.title: Border Security or Bulldozing a National Park? SCOTUS Greenlights Wall Through Big Bend

stories.poll_option2_desc: Irreplaceable public lands and wildlife shouldn't be sacrificed for a wall.
